title: Deploy warmup chorus: health validators and API/model priming orchestrator
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a coordinated post-deploy warmup orchestration (nicknamed 'chorus') that runs API readiness probes, model KV-cache priming, and lightweight model load/quality smoke tests across a VPC deployment. The harness should: 1) run an ordered set of probes (control-plane then API endpoints then model hot starts), 2) stagger priming across shards to avoid bursty egress/cold-cache storms, 3) measure SLO burn-in metrics for the first N minutes and flag regressions, and 4) emit detailed traceable artifacts (logs, traces, synthetic traces) that feed into the Console for post-deploy diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Chorus orchestration can be triggered automatically by Terraform post-deploy hook or manually via CLI
API readiness probe: 95% success on health/readiness endpoints across all replicas for 5 consecutive minutes
Model priming: KV cache warmups occur with stagger < 30s between shard groups and median model load latency < 120ms on warm paths
Smoke generation: a small set of deterministic prompts returns within latency SLO and matches baseline tokens distribution (token-length, top-k match rate) for 90% of samples
Observability: traces and metrics are visible in Console runbook - per-route latency, per-replica priming progress, and a summary artifact uploaded to S3/drive link
Failure mode handling: automatic quiesce and rollback trigger if priming causes >30% error-rate increase or sustained SLA breach for 3m
technical_notes: Orchestrator will be implemented as a small Go binary run from the terraform null_resource local-exec for now, with a goal to convert to a fleet job in runtime-ops later
Priming strategy: group replicas by segment (e.g., hardware rack or AZ) and run cache fills in waves to avoid saturating model-serving network or preemption quotas
Synthetic load: two tiers - functional smoke prompts (deterministic) + light stochastic throughput burst to validate autoscaling signals
Metrics to emit: readiness_ok, priming_progress_pct, priming_latency_ms_p50/p90, smoke_error_rate, slo_burnin_latency_p50/p95
Integrations: upload artifacts to /redwood-private-deploys/<env>/<deploy-id>/chorus-report.json and create a Console trace link in the deployment dashboard
Security: all orchestration traffic uses customer VPC endpoints and service account with least privilege to call admin hooks; keys rotated via KMS per run
comments: 2026-03-02 - Scoping complete. Decided on two-stage priming (control plane -> API -> model). Assigned prototype to Lena.
2026-03-05 - Spike finished: local prototype can prime a 4-replica toy cluster with stagger waves; observed p95 priming latency ~200ms on dev hardware.
2026-03-08 - Design review with SRE and Security. SRE requested priming progress metrics emitted per replica. Security asked for KMS-based ephemeral tokens for admin hooks.
2026-03-11 - Implemented artifact upload to S3 and a minimal Console link. Created initial GH PR for orchestrator binary. Load generator tuned to avoid autoscaler thrashing.
2026-03-13 - Running first integrated test in staging; observed transient API 429s when waves were too tight. Adjusted inter-wave delay and added backoff policy. Continuing validation.
